name: read_template_registry
description: Checks frontend.* node status — implemented vs. planned — before invoking one

name: resolve_dependencies
description: Confirms the selected root/client pair and, on the Next.js path, the exact prerequisites for authentication/forms/tables/dashboards

name: invoke_node
description: Runs a graph node's generate action for the selected root/client pair and supported feature nodes (Next.js: project.nextjs, frontend.nextjs, frontend.authentication, frontend.forms, frontend.tables, frontend.dashboards; Vite React: project.vite-react, frontend.react)
